description: Simulation-generated spatio-temporal dataset capturing mobile sensor telemetry, UAV relay dynamics, and dynamic wireless link qualities under terrain-dependent RF disruptions.

sensor_telemetry_csv.description: Time-series observations of sensor coordinates, velocity, energy, priority, disruption flags, and CS connectivity.

uav_telemetry_csv.description: Time-series flight coordinates, battery state, distance to CS, and coverage metrics.

network_links_csv.description: Dynamic edge list specifying Euclidean distances, link qualities, and disruption crossing status.

graph_snapshots_npz.description: Compressed binary tensors for Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network (ST-GNN) training and evaluation.

temporal_features: T0 -> T1 -> ... -> Tn timesteps with graph evolution per step
